# EcclesiaOS v1.0.36

## Release summary

EcclesiaOS v1.0.36 delivers a substantial church website, sermon, member registration, localization, leadership reporting, and frontend reliability update. This release also completes a production-readiness cleanup of Website Studio: the administrator interface now exposes only the fully working Grace & Community public template, while unsupported experimental template choices and legacy values are safely normalized.

## Website Studio and public church website

- Added a full Website Studio for configuring the church’s public website from inside EcclesiaOS.
- Added homepage editing for hero text, welcome content, experience content, sermon next steps, service details, giving content, footer text, contact information, SEO metadata, colors, fonts, logo, hero images, and hero videos.
- Added page creation, editing, publishing, previewing, archiving, slug management, section selection, section ordering, and page-level SEO controls.
- Added reusable sections that can be assigned to one or more pages and updated centrally.
- Added a section builder with headings, text, quotes, buttons, icons, images, galleries, cards, carousels, video sliders, columns, spacers, uploaded media, linked media, and background video support.
- Added media library support for uploaded website assets and safe public media URLs.
- Added responsive public website layouts for navigation, hero content, services, ministries, campuses, sermons, events, giving, bookstore products, contact details, and reusable sections.
- Added public preview links for unpublished or in-progress website changes.
- Added visitor light/dark theme switching with an administrator-controlled default theme.
- Removed non-working experimental template choices from Website Studio. Grace & Community is now the only selectable and supported production template.
- Added safe normalization for existing churches that previously stored an unsupported template value.

## Sermons and YouTube integration

- Added sermon administration with create, edit, publish, archive, search, filter, Scripture, speaker, summary, date, thumbnail, and video fields.
- Added public sermon detail pages with related sermons and metadata.
- Added sermon cards and sermon links throughout the public website.
- Added encrypted YouTube OAuth credential storage and administrator integration settings.
- Added YouTube connection callbacks, synchronization diagnostics, and idempotent synchronization.
- Added synchronization support for upcoming, live, and completed YouTube videos.

## Member registration and localization

- Added a reusable share-registration-link component to the dashboard and Members module.
- Added public member self-registration without requiring an existing login.
- Added returning-member matching to prevent duplicate member records.
- Added optional account creation, member-role assignment, campus and ministry restrictions, and optional check-in during registration.
- Added locale persistence and language switching for English, Spanish, and French.
- Added translated registration forms, validation errors, interface resources, and footer content.
- Added safeguards preventing registration data from being attached to a different member or unauthorized campus/ministry.

## Leadership reports and workflow improvements

- Added personal leadership report templates.
- Added report creation, review, decision, completion, reminders, escalation windows, and reviewer-role restrictions.
- Added leadership report analytics, dashboard summaries, quick actions, and reviewer configuration.
- Added support for saved report templates and direct creation from personal templates.

## Reliability and quality fixes

- Fixed translation fallback errors for longer rendered phrases.
- Fixed locale catalog filtering runtime errors.
- Registered all static Lucide icons used in Blade templates and corrected dynamic Alpine icon detection.
- Fixed website preview fallback behavior when an unsupported legacy template is encountered.
- Fixed website starter content refresh behavior after template normalization.
- Fixed sermon related-content and thumbnail rendering issues.
- Added and expanded automated coverage across Website Studio, registration, sermons, YouTube synchronization, attendance, leadership reports, access control, communications, payments, support, and operational modules.

## Upgrade notes

- The release uses database migrations for website pages, sermon records, YouTube integration data, YouTube metadata, synchronization diagnostics, and leadership report templates.
- Existing website settings using unsupported experimental template identifiers will render using Grace & Community after upgrade.
- The release package requires PHP 8.2 or newer and includes database migrations.
- Back up the application and database before installation. The managed updater records a release backup before applying migrations.

## Verification

- 263 automated tests passed.
- 3,040 assertions passed.
- Website regression tests passed with 279 assertions after the single-template cleanup.
- Blade view compilation and route registration passed.
- Frontend production build passed.
